maintenance_led.reason: Sells freshly made coffee, energy drinks and other beverages to consumers at drive-thru shops; consumables, not repair or maintenance.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from consumers buying drinks at Dutch Bros drive-thru shops, not from government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by opening its own company-operated drive-thru shops and franchising, and by selling more drinks.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers can easily switch to other coffee and drink chains; the products are discretionary, with no switching cost.
